title: Successful restore leaves cached VPN decisions stale
reproduction: PROPOSED NOT RUN: warm an ALLOWED lookup for restore-cache.example in the application VPN model; restore a small backup blocking it; query the same model without any other apply or update.
expected: A successful restored user-rule change reaches active VPN decisions before reporting completion without enabling a stopped VPN.
observed: Importer commits hosts_lists and source counters but never invalidates the application VPN cache; DAO resolves the new rule while the same model keeps its prior cached ALLOWED result until eviction or unrelated invalidation.
fix: Reconcile runtime metadata and invalidate application VPN rules after successful transaction through the existing coordinated application-owned path; preserve stopped/failed-import behavior and avoid privileged-root writes.
test_evidence: Source trace only: VpnModel caches allowed results; HostEntryDao resolves current user rows on cache miss; SourceModel.syncHostEntries invalidates but restore never calls it. Proposed same-model Room/public-URI import regression with inverse and malformed controls; not written or run. Distinct from NOV-VPN-02 in-flight replacement race.

title: Successful exports can exceed the importer's hard limits
reproduction: PROPOSED NOT RUN: export 201 distinct valid HTTPS subscriptions with no user rules; import that exact successful export into a clean fixture. Also cover 50001 user rules.
expected: Every successful export is usable by the importer or export explicitly fails before modifying its destination; input protection remains bounded.
observed: Exporter emits every source/rule and reports success; importer rejects above 200 sources or 50000 total user rules or 16 Mi characters before any mutation. BackupAgent reuses the same pair.
fix: Share capacity validation before destination opening and report unrestorable exports as failures; prefer a bounded round-trippable large-backup format without silently dropping rows or removing hostile-input limits.
test_evidence: Source-confirmed only; existing over-limit import test covers rejection rather than export compatibility. Proposed 200/201 source and 50000/50001 rule export/import tests plus character limit and unopened-output assertion; not written or run.

title: Restore silently ignores saved settings for existing source URLs
reproduction: PROPOSED NOT RUN: export a disabled source labeled Saved; change the existing same-URL source to enabled and label Current; restore the exported file.
expected: Saved permitted source fields are restored with stable identity or conflicts are explicitly presented to the user.
observed: Importer calls insertAll whose DAO uses IGNORE on a unique URL; existing source keeps Current and enabled=true despite ordinary import success. Deliberate redirect-trust reset is not the defect.
fix: Reconcile sources by URL transactionally while preserving IDs and row relationships; restore allowed configuration fields with existing selection/format invalidation semantics and retain redirect restrictions; expose conflicts if merge-only is intentional.
test_evidence: Source-confirmed against HostsSourceDao.java:32-36 and HostsSource.java:29-32; proposed one-source Room backup/change/restore test checks label/enabled/row propagation and stable ID with new-URL and redirect-policy controls; not written or run.

title: IPv6 and monitor switches save values without updating the active VPN
reproduction: PROPOSED NOT RUN: start VPN with monitor off; switch it on and return on a stable network; existing watchdog stays disabled. Separately toggle IPv6 during a stable dual-stack VPN and inspect existing routes; reverse both toggles.
expected: Visible settings become effective in the active VPN without an unrelated restart; stopped VPN stays stopped.
observed: Neither control has a change/reconfiguration listener; VpnWorker captures watchdog enabled once and DnsServerMapper reads IPv6 only during VPN configuration. Existing bypass/system-exclusion restart wiring does not cover these controls.
fix: Bind both switches to post-persistence reconfiguration of the currently active VPN or safe in-place monitor updates; preserve consent/stopped/root-mode boundaries.
test_evidence: Source-confirmed from worker/watchdog and DNS configuration excerpts only; proposed actual-switch active-worker tests assert changed watchdog state and IPv6 configuration plus on/off/recreation/stopped controls. Existing bypass runtime and preference-only tests do not cover these controls. No runtime executed; distinct from NOV-VPN-05 route construction.
